host.label: Management IP address or hostname
host.description: Specify the IP address or hostname of the data source

port.label: Host port
port.description: Set the port number that is associated with the hostname or IP address

org_id.label: Organisation ID
org_id.description: Axiom organisation ID. Only needed with a personal access token.

help.label: Need additional help?
help.description: More details on the data source setting can be found in the specified link

dataset.label: Dataset
dataset.description: Axiom dataset to search, for example ocsf

field_schema.label: Field layout
field_schema.description: How the dataset's fields are named: ocsf (Axiom OCSF schema), windows (Windows Security and Sysmon fields), a comma-separated list, or all

field_map.label: Extra field mapping
field_map.description: JSON object that adds dataset fields to STIX properties, for example {"ipv4-addr": {"fields": {"value": ["client_ip"]}}}

api_key.label: API token
api_key.description: Axiom API token with query permission on the dataset
